credits.title: Greed & Gore
credits.overview: After a Heist goes wrong, the thieves find refuge at an abandoned house. Unbeknownst to them, something evil and violent awaits.  Upcoming Canadian feature adaptation of the Award Winning horror short of the same name.

credits.title: In a Violent Nature: Part 2
credits.overview: Johnny heads to a summer camp, where he crosses paths with a young, outcast camper who is forced to spend the night with his counselor sister and her friends at their annual end-of-season party

credits.title: Silent Bite
credits.overview: A gang of bank robbers take shelter in a motel after a Christmas Eve bank heist. Unbeknownst to them, they are not the most dangerous thing seeking refuge on this cold Christmas night.

credits.title: What Lurks Beneath
credits.overview: The crew of USS Titan find themselves on the brink of World War 3 with Russia, when a naked stowaway appears in one of their torpedo tubes. The captain banks fears she may be Russian, but she's something far more dangerous.

credits.title: Abducted Off the Street: The Carlesha Gaither Story
credits.overview: Philadelphia nurse Carlesha Gaither is abducted off the street by a killer. She fights to survive and leaves clues to aid her rescue.
